tickerText: [TENNIS] Iva Jovic defends the Guadalajara Open with a 6-4, 6-2 win over Peyton Stearns while Davis Cup qualifying sends Czechia past the United States as Jakub Mensik beats Ben Shelton and Jiri Lehecka tops Learner Tien, South Korea becomes the first Asian nation in the Final 8, and Great Britain leads Ecuador 2-0 in London • [SQUASH] Mostafa Asal's 11-5, 11-6, 11-2 Qatar Classic final over Victor Crouin is his 30th PSA title and completes the set of current majors as Amina Orfi's five-set win over Hania El Hammamy lifts her to world No. 1 in Doha • [BADMINTON] Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games team badminton opens Sept. 20 at Ichinomiya with knockout ties including India's women versus Kazakhstan at 11:30 a.m. IST and the men facing Bangladesh on Monday ahead of singles week • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Arizona Open Championship Sunday in Mesa caps a $1.06M PPA week that saw Tyson McGuffin bounced in the Round of 32 while pro finals stream on PickleballTV and FS1 with 1,000 ranking points in play • [TABLE TENNIS] India opens Asian Games women's team play with a 3-0 sweep of Indonesia—Akula, Chitale and Ghorpade winning singles—before a Sunday Singapore tie while WTT Star Contender Astana closes its Kazakhstan slate with singles finals at the Martial Arts Palace

newsItems.title: Czechia Knocks Out USA
newsItems.excerpt: Jakub Mensik beat Ben Shelton 5-7, 6-4, 6-3 and Jiri Lehecka edged Learner Tien 6-3, 7-5 on Sept. 20 to send Czechia into the Davis Cup Final 8, with Shelton losing both singles rubbers in Prague.

newsItems.title: Asal Completes Major Set
newsItems.excerpt: Mostafa Asal swept Victor Crouin for his first Qatar Classic crown and 30th PSA title, while Amina Orfi outlasted Hania El Hammamy in five games to take the women's trophy and the world No. 1 ranking in Doha.

newsItems.title: Asian Games Badminton Begins
newsItems.excerpt: Team knockout play at Ichinomiya opened on Sept. 20 as India's women faced Kazakhstan in the round of 16, with the men's tie against Bangladesh set for Monday before quarterfinals later in the week.

newsItems.title: India Sweeps Indonesia 3-0
newsItems.excerpt: Sreeja Akula, Diya Chitale and Yashaswini Ghorpade won their singles rubbers on Sept. 20 as India's women's table tennis team blanked Indonesia in Asian Games Group F before facing Singapore later Sunday.
